name: Milly's Harvest
summary: Defias brigands have driven Milly Osworth from the Northshire vineyards. Her harvest lies scattered in buckets and crates among the occupied rows, where it may be stolen or crushed.

sections.title: A Crop Left Behind
sections.body: Milly Osworth fled the southeastern fields of Northshire Valley when Defias brigands swarmed the vines. She left her gathered grapes behind in buckets and crates among the occupied rows. Northshire's garrison is stretched thin, and Milly fears that boots and fighting will crush any fruit the bandits leave behind.

sections.title: Northshire Under Pressure
sections.body: Defias bandits now occupy working vineyards, a sign of how little safety Northshire can offer. Stormwind's attention is elsewhere, and the valley has too few guards. Farmers like Milly must depend on recruits and wanderers to protect their property and secure the food and wine that supply the abbey.

faq.answer: Milly Osworth farms the Northshire Vineyards. She tends and harvests the valley's grapes, but the arriving Defias Brotherhood drove her from her fields.

faq.q: Why can't the Northshire guards retrieve the harvest?
faq.answer: Northshire Valley's guards are too few and occupied with the widespread bandit threat and kobold infestations. Milly also fears that a military sweep could trample her grapes into the mud.

faq.q: What are the Defias doing in the vineyards?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has entered Northshire Valley to disrupt regional production, harass the local people, and seize resources under Stormwind's guards' noses.
The harvest buckets and crates are scattered across the ground in the Northshire Vineyards, just southeast of Northshire Abbey, among Defias brigands patrolling the rows.

faq.q: What happens after Milly gets her grapes back?
faq.answer: After her harvest is safe, Milly asks you to bring her Grape Manifest to Brother Neals inside Northshire Abbey, so the yield can be accounted for and processed into wine.

faq.q: Why are grapes important to Northshire Abbey?
faq.answer: Northshire Valley produces famous wine and supplies the clerical community at the abbey. Milly's crop sustains local trade and the cellars maintained by the Brotherhood of Northshire.

angles.text: Recovering Milly's crop gives young Alliance recruits a first look at the Defias threat only miles from Stormwind City.
As a human beginning your journey in Northshire, protecting smallholder farmers like Milly is part of defending Elwynn's working folk.
